item.title: ‘No offence but you are free to take it’: Federal pollies demand apology from Connolly as further public comments revealed
item.description: Federal Minister for Indigenous Australians Malarandirri McCarthy and two federal MPs have labelled incoming NT Administrator David Connolly's social media comments "reprehensible and offensive" and called for a public apology, while a national media outlet has reported further racially-charged commentary during a 2024 speech in which Mr Connolly also said that while he does not "offer offence, you are free to take it".

item.title: Serious crash south of Alice Springs under investigation
item.description: NT Police are seeking the public's assistance as it continues to investigate the circumstances of a vehicle rollover on the Stuart Highway south of Stuarts Well on Wednesday afternoon, that allegedly started with a failure to pay for fuel and ended with one man ejected from his vehicle and another arrested.

item.title: Letter to the editor: New Administrator should be Billy not David
item.description: The media might have been putting out fake news when they said David Connolly was the new Administrator because the comedian Billy Connolly would be the right choice, writes Gerry Wood.

item.title: Organisers want 500 utes in 25th anniversary Australia Day convoy
item.description: Variety NT's Tania Sellers says the organisers want to get 500 vehicles in convoy in the Australia Day Ute Run to celebrate the event's 25th anniversary.

item.title: ‘Directly undermines integrity’: NT ranks behind corrupt island nation for independence of Auditor-General
item.description: Papua New Guinea's Auditor-General has more independence from the executive branch of government than the Northern Territory's, according to a startling report, which has raised concerns about how effectively the NT Government is held to account for its exorbitant spending of taxpayer funds.

item.title: Reece Kershaw named interim St John Ambulance CEO
item.description: Former NT Police and Australian Federal Police commissioner Reece Kershaw has been appointed the interim chief executive officer of the troubled St John Ambulance NT organisation until the recruitment process for the role is finished, the organisation said.

item.title: Basketball Australia quiet on integrity investigation into Darwin Basketball Association
item.description: Basketball Australia will not comment on the findings of its national integrity unit’s investigation into questionable proposed income streams at the now-defunct Darwin Basketball Association, while former DBA chair Gary Shipway has not responded to questions, with his employer, News Corp, stating his role overseeing the financially collapsed association is unrelated to his current role as deputy editor of the NT News.

item.title: Holtze Prison inmate treated for diphtheria
item.description: A Holtze Prison inmate is being treated for a less serious form of diphtheria, the Northern Territory Centre for Disease Control has confirmed.

item.title: Police executives among three officers issued disciplinary notices for alleged racist comments
item.description: Three senior NT Police officers, including two executives, were issued with serious discipline breach notices for alleged racist comments during a recent senior management meeting, with one of the accused identified as one of five officers who lied in a statutory declaration to the Kumanjayi Walker coronial inquest, sources have told the NT Independent.

item.title: ‘Undermines trust and respect’: Aboriginal peak body calls for Feds to revoke Administrator appointment
item.description: The peak body representing Aboriginal organisations in the Territory has rejected David Connolly as the next NT Administrator and called for the NT and Federal Governments to terminate his appointment following his recently revealed social media comments and views that they say "undermine trust and respect across our diverse population".
